reply.shortGloss: to close; to shut; to turn off
reply.emotion: firm and decisive, finishing a task
notes: Cerrar changes its stem from e to ie in present tense forms (cierro, cierras, cierra).
Do not confuse cerrar (to close) with cerca (close by/near).

senses.definition: Hacer que una puerta, ventana o acceso deje de estar abierto.

examples.text: Voy a cerrar la ventana porque hace frío.
examples.translation: I am going to close the window because it is cold.
examples.emotion: practical and purposeful, reacting to the chilly air

senses.definition: Interrumpir el paso de un líquido o gas abriendo o girando un mecanismo.

examples.text: No olvides cerrar la llave del agua.
examples.translation: Do not forget to turn off the water faucet.
examples.emotion: caring and instructional, giving a helpful reminder

senses.definition: Poner fin a un negocio, una tienda o una actividad de manera temporal o definitiva.

examples.text: La panadería suele cerrar temprano los domingos.
examples.translation: The bakery usually closes early on Sundays.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and informative, sharing a local routine
